lessons.title: Endpoint Testing & Interval of Convergence

formulas: ratio/root tests often give no endpoint decision
lessons.solution1: R=1; at x=3 harmonic diverges, at x=1 alternating converges, so [1,3).
lessons.solution2: R=1 and both endpoints converge absolutely: [−1,1].

lessons.title: Capstone Synthesis, Oral Defense & Calculus III Bridge
lessons.focus: integrating methods, convergence, modelling, communication, and responsible technology use
formulas: claim + derivation + evidence + limitation + next question
lessons.example1: Name four required elements of the capstone defense.
lessons.solution1: Mathematical model, justified method, validated result, and limitation/sensitivity analysis.
lessons.example2: What topics form the Calculus III bridge?
lessons.solution2: Vectors in space, multivariable functions, partial derivatives, multiple integrals, and vector fields—previewed but not substituted for Calculus II mastery.
